title: Security Incident Response
description:
**\#Cyber Security Experts\#****Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced Security Incident Response Manager to lead our organizations ability to detect respond to contain and recover from cybersecurity incidents


The role focuses on safeguarding card and payment ecosystems through robust identity management advanced endpoint defense security analytics and incident response practices while enabling a secure hybrid work model.

  



**Responsibilities**


Incident Response Leadership


Serve as the Incident Commander for major security incidents coordinating technical responders leadership legal PR and business stakeholders


Own and continuously mature the organizations Incident Response Plan IRP playbooks and runbooks across threat categories ransomware data breach insider threat DDoS business email compromise supply chain compromise etc


Team Program Management


Build mentor and manage a team of incident responders andor coordinate a virtual crossfunctional IR team SOC IT legal HR comms


Define and track IR KPIsmetrics MTTD MTTR containment time recurrence rate and report trends to the CISO and executive leadership


Run regular tabletop exercises purple team simulations and IR drills to test organizational readiness


Threat Detection Forensics


Partner with the SOCThreat Detection team to refine detection use cases alert triage workflows and escalation criteria


Oversee digital forensics and root cause analysis RCA efforts ensuring proper chainofcustody and evidence handling


Required Qualifications


6 years of experience in cybersecurity with at least 3 years directly in incident response SOC leadership or digital forensics


Proven experience leading response efforts for significant security incidents breach ransomware insider threat etc


Strong working knowledge of incident response frameworks NIST 80061 SANS MITRE ATTCK


Handson experience with SIEM Splunk EDRXDR Defender SOAR platforms and forensic tools EnCase FTK Volatility etc


Solid understanding of networking endpoint cloud AWSAzureGCP and identity security concepts


Experience managing or mentoring a team or coordinating crossfunctional virtual teams during highpressure events


Excellent written and verbal communication skills able to translate technical detail into businessrelevant risk narratives for executives and boards

* Collaborate with security operations teams to enhance SOC and SIEM monitoring coverage by defining tuning and validating alerts that focus on high value cardholder data assets and critical transaction flows.
* Conduct forensic investigations using FTK and EnCase to identify root causes of security incidents within card and payment systems and to support evidence driven containment and recovery actions.
* Define endpoint security strategies using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to protect workstations servers and payment processing endpoints from malware ransomware and advanced persistent threats.
* Partner with networking teams to design secure network topologies for data centers branches and cloud environments that apply strong segmentation encryption and traffic inspection controls for payment data paths.
* Coordinate with incident management stakeholders to ensure escalation paths communication plans and post incident reviews consistently reduce response times and improve resilience of payment services.
* Create and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams playbooks standards and best practices that guide teams in operating and evolving security capabilities for card and payment platforms.
* Engage with product and engineering teams to embed security requirements into the software delivery lifecycle ensuring that new features for cards and payments are designed tested and deployed with strong preventive and detective controls.
* Provide mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers and junior security professionals by conducting workshops tabletop exercises and training sessions focused on cloud security identity security and incident handling for payment systems.

  



**Qualifications**

* possess eight to ten years of progressive experience in cyber security architecture with substantial exposure to large scale enterprise or financial services environments that operate card and payment platforms.
* demonstrate deep hands on expertise with Microsoft Identity Manager including design deployment and integration with cloud identity services and enterprise directories that support secure access to critical systems.
* show strong proficiency in securing AWS GCP and Azure cloud environments covering identity and access management network controls logging encryption key management and integration with central SIEM platforms.
* exhibit robust knowledge of networking concepts including routing switching firewalls load balancing VPNs DNS and secure connectivity patterns that support resilient payment processing infrastructures.
* display practical experience using FTK and EnCase for digital forensics covering evidence acquisition timeline analysis artifact review and report creation that supports incident response and compliance needs.
* apply advanced skills with ServiceNow SOAR for building playbooks connectors and automated workflows that orchestrate enrichment response and collaboration activities across SOC teams.
* leverage Microsoft Defender for Endpoint to design policies detections and response strategies that address threats targeting user devices servers and specialized payment endpoints.
* utilize Splunk SIEM to build dashboards correlation searches threat detection rules and reports that support continuous monitoring of cardholder data environments and cloud workloads.
* apply Mitre ATTandCK framework knowledge to map adversary behaviors identify control gaps and prioritize detections that align with realistic threats to payment ecosystems.
* bring solid experience working in SOC and SIEM driven operations including tuning alerts improving runbooks collaborating with analysts and enhancing coverage for high risk systems.
* demonstrate strong incident management capabilities including triage investigation containment eradication recovery and post incident reviews with emphasis on minimizing customer impact.
* present proven domain experience in cards and payments including understanding of transaction flows authorization clearing settlement cardholder data protection and relevant regulatory expectations.
* communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders through clear documentation presentations and discussions that support informed decision making on security architecture tradeoffs.

title: Administration Manager
description:
**About JMN Medical College and Hospital**  
JMN Medical College and Hospital is a 150\-seat MBBS institution recognised under the National Medical Commission and located at Uttar Panchpota, Chakdaha, Nadia. We are a young institution building our systems, culture and reputation from the ground up, and the people we hire now will design how this institution works for years to come.

**The Role**  
We are looking for an Administration Manager of high intelligence and sharp judgement to run the institution's day\-to\-day administration and coordinate across departments, so the college operates smoothly and meets every regulatory requirement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate administrative operations across academic, clinical and support departments.
* Prepare and maintain documentation for NMC inspections, university affiliation and statutory bodies.
* Support institutional committees with notices, minutes and record\-keeping.
* Manage official correspondence, file systems and records.
* Oversee front office, visitor management and general services.
* Track institutional deadlines and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

**Who You Are**

* You hold the whole institution in your head: deadlines, dependencies, committees and regulatory cycles, and you keep them all moving.
* You turn NMC and university requirements into clear systems, checklists and accountability.
* You write with exceptional clarity. Your drafts need no correction.
* You spot inconsistencies, missing documents and emerging risks long before an inspection does.
* You learn quickly, anticipate problems and hold yourself to exacting standards.

**Digital and AI Skills**

* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, compliance calendars, dashboards.
* Experience with digital file management, document tracking and cloud collaboration tools.
* You look for ways to automate routine administrative work and adopt new tools quickly.

**Requirements**

* Postgraduate degree in any discipline. An MBA or MHA is preferred.
* 6–10 years of administrative experience, including at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Experience in a medical college or healthcare institution is strongly preferred.
* Excellent drafting skills and a strong command of English.

**Selection Process**  
Our selection process tests how you think, not only what you know:

* CV and cover letter shortlisting
* Assessment of analytical, logical reasoning \& psychometric analysis
* Panel interview with institutional leadership

**How to Apply**  
Apply through Indeed with your CV and a one\-page cover letter. In the cover letter, describe the most complex administrative problem you have solved and how you reasoned through it, and one tool, automation or AI application you introduced that made your work measurably better.

*Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications, experience and demonstrated ability. JMN Medical College and Hospital is an equal opportunity employer.*

Pay: ₹75,000\.00 \- ₹90,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Application Question(s):

* Which digital tools and AI applications do you use for administrative work, and how have they improved it?
* Describe a time you managed many competing deadlines or a complex inspection. How did you keep everything on track?

title: Video Editor – Creative & Conceptual Content
description:
Job Summary



SAI is looking for a creative and technically skilled **Video Editor** who can transform raw footage, product demonstrations, ideas, and concepts into engaging and professional video content.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable handling both **standard video editing** and **creative/concept\-driven video production**. The role requires someone who can understand the purpose of a video, develop a visual storytelling approach, and create content that is clear, modern, engaging, and aligned with the SAI brand.



Key Responsibilities


* Edit raw video footage into polished, professional final videos.
* Perform standard editing tasks including cutting, trimming, sequencing, transitions, audio synchronization, subtitles, and basic color correction.
* Create creative and visually engaging videos for product launches, presentations, marketing campaigns, social media, events, and internal communication.
* Develop videos from a concept, script, storyboard, or rough idea.
* Convert technical or product\-related information into simple and engaging visual stories.
* Create strong opening sequences, title cards, end screens, callouts, highlights, and visual emphasis.
* Add motion graphics, text animations, icons, overlays, screen recordings, and graphical elements where required.
* Work with software/product demonstration recordings and make them easy for viewers to understand.
* Synchronize voiceovers, background music, sound effects, animations, and on\-screen activity accurately.
* Create concept videos that communicate the vision of a product, technology, feature, or future experience.
* Improve raw or ordinary footage through creative pacing, transitions, visual effects, sound design, and storytelling.
* Produce short\-form and long\-form content depending on the platform and project requirement.
* Create content suitable for presentations, exhibitions, customer demonstrations, social media, websites, and corporate communication.
* Maintain visual consistency across SAI videos, including typography, branding, transitions, colors, logos, and overall presentation style.
* Review completed videos carefully for visual, audio, spelling, timing, and synchronization issues.
* Manage multiple video projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Organize project files, raw footage, exported videos, graphics, audio, and reusable video assets properly.
* Work closely with product, design, marketing, and management teams to understand project requirements and incorporate feedback.


Types of Video Work



The candidate should be comfortable working across different video styles, including:


**Normal / Standard Video Editing**


* Product demonstrations
* Screen recordings
* Training videos
* Tutorial videos
* Corporate videos
* Internal communication videos
* Event videos
* Presentation videos


**Creative Video Editing**


* Promotional videos
* Product launch videos
* Social media content
* Brand videos
* Highlight videos
* Exhibition and event content
* Cinematic product presentations
* Visually engaging feature demonstrations


**Concept Video Editing**


* Product concept videos
* Future technology demonstrations
* Vision videos
* Story\-driven product presentations
* Feature visualization
* UI/UX concept presentations
* Before\-and\-after scenarios
* Problem\-to\-solution storytelling
* Technology and AI concept videos


Required Skills


* Strong understanding of video editing principles and visual storytelling.
* Good sense of pacing, timing, composition, typography, and visual hierarchy.
* Ability to convert an idea or rough brief into a complete video.
* Ability to understand the objective and audience before starting an edit.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good understanding of audio editing and synchronization.
* Knowledge of color correction and basic color grading.
* Experience with motion graphics and animated text.
* Ability to work with screen recordings and software demonstrations.
* Ability to select suitable music, sound effects, transitions, and visual styles.
* Ability to manage feedback and revise videos efficiently.


Preferred Software Knowledge



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:


* Adobe Premiere Pro
* Adobe After Effects
* DaVinci Resolve
* Final Cut Pro
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* CapCut or similar editing tools
* AI\-assisted video, image, voice, or animation tools


Knowledge of motion graphics, compositing, 2D/3D animation, or basic Blender/Cinema 4D workflows would be an advantage.



Creative Expectations



We are looking for someone who does more than simply cut footage.



The editor should be able to look at raw content and think:


* What is the main message?
* How should the video begin?
* What should the viewer notice first?
* Where should the video slow down or speed up?
* What visual treatment will make the content easier to understand?
* How can an ordinary product demonstration become more engaging?
* What graphics, animation, sound, or storytelling will strengthen the message?
* How can a complex technology concept be explained visually?


The ability to **think creatively before editing** is an important part of this role.



Qualifications


* Degree/Diploma in Video Editing, Film, Media, Animation, Graphic Design, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
* Relevant professional or freelance video\-editing experience.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating previous work.
* Candidates with strong practical skills and an excellent portfolio will be considered regardless of formal qualification.


Portfolio Requirement



Candidates should provide examples demonstrating at least some of the following:


* Standard video editing
* Creative editing
* Product or corporate videos
* Motion graphics
* Concept videos
* Promotional content
* Screen\-recording/product demonstration videos
* Social media content


What We Are Looking For



We are looking for a **Video Editor who combines technical editing ability with creative thinking**.



The right candidate should be able to take:


**Raw Footage / Screen Recording / Basic Idea**  **Understand the Message**  **Develop a Concept**  **Create the Story**  **Edit**  **Add Graphics \& Sound**  **Deliver a Professional Final Video**
